title: Open Logix remote config index
description: The config version folders of a component's remote config: remote-config/<product>/index.jsonc (Remote updates, in the website repo's CLAUDE.md). A component reads it to find its newest release in a config version newer than its own, without listing folders through the GitHub API. It lists exactly the version folders there, oldest first.

versions.description: The config version folders, such as 001, oldest first.
